## [1.10.0](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0) (2026-10-30)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* address release and bundle review findings ([9e91db1](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/9e91db1d2b632540ac7692bbacbd29f43c741a46))
* **deps:** pin handlebars to 4.7.10 ([6cb203c](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/6cb203cce9da410288aea39c6d12fdce19f2d4e7))
* **zalo:** remove all matching native crash handler calls ([37bbb6a](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/37bbb6ace5dc0a3847a543a35909e478d2743554))

### ✨ New Features

* refresh patch descriptions ([50cf3bc](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/50cf3bcb876498360d073d108174677123619ab6))
* **zalo:** allow stranger box notifications ([90301d1](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/90301d176e5b2c770a6fce7faa287da2d52cea6b))

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **threads:** add 453.0.0.56.79 support ([afd1f77](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/afd1f77265091bb1e6d49172d4ea2c7be3361659))
* **zalo:** add 26.10.02 support ([07250d5](https://github.com/zeldrisho/morphe-patches/commit/07250d5ce9e08b9918bfd880aaf92ae2b7ba440b))

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown in the launcher.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Allows a renamed clone alongside Threads. Login, content providers or push may break.

options.description: The new application package name (e.g. com.instagram.barcelona.morphe).

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts from the Threads feed. Other surfaces are unaffected.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens web links externally when possible; otherwise Threads handles them normally.

patches.name: Remove AD_ID permission
patches.description: Removes advertising ID permissions. Meta's own analytics are unaffected.

patches.name: Bypass Zalo Drive Contacts permission gate
patches.description: Allows Drive photo restore account selection without Contacts permission.

patches.name: Bypass native startup tamper check
patches.description: Allows the re-signed app to start on the supported arm64 Zalo build.

patches.name: Change Zalo app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown in the launcher.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Change Zalo package name
patches.description: Allows a renamed clone alongside Zalo. Login, push, sharing and deep links may be affected.

options.description: The new application package name (for example com.zing.zalo.morphe).

patches.name: Configurable native backup interval
patches.description: Sets Zalo's automatic backup interval to 1, 3, 6 or 12 hours. Existing backup requirements still apply.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Blocks selected offline and Google-served ads. Story and community sponsored placements require a separate patch.

patches.name: Disable sponsored placements
patches.description: Disables Story and community sponsored placements. Server-delivered and Official Account promotions may remain.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and crash reporting
patches.description: Stops selected Zalo analytics and crash reporting. Messaging is unaffected.

patches.name: Enable Google Drive photo backup
patches.description: Makes Zalo's Google Drive photo backup available to more accounts. Google authorization and Drive retention still apply.

patches.name: Enable avatar saving
patches.description: Restores Save photo for avatars opened from a profile and allows screenshots. Other screenshot protections are unchanged.

patches.name: Enable profile cover saving
patches.description: Restores Save photo for profile cover photos and allows screenshots. Other viewers are unchanged.

patches.name: Enable stranger notifications
patches.description: Allows notifications for Stranger Box messages. Other notification settings, message delivery and server restrictions still apply.

patches.name: Filter promo notifications
patches.description: Filters Timeline, Stories and Zalo Video notifications. Message, call, friend-request and birthday notifications are unaffected.

patches.name: Hide Business Box
patches.description: Hides Business Box from the chat list without hiding ordinary or user-initiated Official Account chats.

patches.name: Hide Media Box
patches.description: Hides Media Box from the chat list without deleting its content.

patches.name: Hide chat list ads
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the chat list. Server-delivered promotions and other ads may remain.

patches.name: Keep expired media accessible
patches.description: Keeps locally stored large chat media accessible after expiry. Missing files and server restrictions are unaffected.

patches.name: Prefer original photo quality
patches.description: Enables original photo quality by default. Upload limits and video are unaffected.

patches.name: Remove AD_ID permission
patches.description: Removes Zalo's advertising ID permissions. Messaging is unaffected.

patches.name: Remove media backup age limit
patches.description: Includes media of any age in Zalo's Google Drive backup. Drive retention and excluded media still apply.

patches.name: Suppress outbound seen status
patches.description: Stops sending read receipts. Incoming read status and message delivery are unaffected.

patches.name: Suppress outbound typing status
patches.description: Stops sending typing indicators. Incoming typing status is unaffected.

patches.name: microG Drive support
patches.description: Uses microG-RE for Google Drive account selection and sign-in. Requires app.revanced.android.gms and the app.revanced account type.
